summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust (the Trust) completed the acquisition of a 72-megawatt data center facility in Gainesville, Virginia via its indirect subsidiary NVAI1A LLC for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $860.6 million, subject to closing adjustments. The facility is 100% leased to a hyperscaler customer. The acquisition was funded by the Trust's available cash from its continuous private offering and a new property-level mortgage loan securitized through CMBS bonds, some of which were purchased by affiliates of the Trust. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The deal had been previously disclosed in an 8-K filed May 22, 2026. Watch for any regulatory or financing contingencies, though completion suggests minimal risk.
